mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 74 degrees at Verona Community Park under mainly clear skies with a waning crescent moon visible.

City updates include phase two of the Aldi development beginning the week of September 7, which will cause traffic shifts on Highway M, and the Military Ridge State Trail paving project, which will close the trail between Lincoln and South Franklin Street from mid-September to mid-November.

There is plenty to do with live music happening today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and trivia starting this Monday at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, 2026, they were informed of an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and student from 2019, leading to the arrest of a 34-year-old Madison resident.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
